newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's four-month insurance premiums up 8.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's four-month insurance premiums up 8.7 pct.

text.p: Premiums at Brazilian insurance companies rose 8.7 percent to 5.6 billion reais in the first four months of 1997, compared with the same period of last year, said the National Federation of Insurance Companies (FENASEG).
Car, health and life insurance accounted for most of the premiums, it said.
Retained claims totalled 3.3 billion reais between January and April, it added. It also said sales expenses amounted to 952 million reais, against 955 million reais in the same period last year.
